integrity: A self-contained human-readable proof and an independently implemented exact arithmetic checker are supplied. Independent evaluation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labelled permutations and the vertex support of cycles of exactly length two. No corresponding claim for other cycle lengths, Ewens weights or non-Euclidean inverse norms. Finite exact checks are corroborative and are not an infinite proof. Literature priority is qualified by the documented bounded comparisons.
title: Sharp Walsh conditioning and central-frequency minima for permutation two-cycle supports
